headline: Baycurrent Classic Round 2: Mitchell and Bridgeman share 36-hole lead at -11
whyCareReason: Keith Mitchell and Jacob Bridgeman share the halfway lead at 11 under par in Yokohama, two strokes clear of Max Homa.
teaser: Bridgeman and Mitchell carded 131 through 36 holes. Homa, Bauchou, Kohles and Meissner lurk at 9 under entering the weekend.
story: Keith Mitchell and Jacob Bridgeman share the 36-hole lead at 11 under par after Friday's second round of the Baycurrent Classic at Yokohama Country Club. In ideal scoring conditions on the par-71 West Course, Mitchell followed his opening 66 with a 65, while Bridgeman posted a 66 to match him at 131. A congested chasing pack sits just two shots back at 9 under, led by Max Homa, Zach Bauchou, Ben Kohles and Mac Meissner. Major champion Justin Thomas, Stephan Jaeger and Australia's Min Woo Lee are among those sharing seventh at 8 under. With no 36-hole cut in the 72-player limited field, all contenders will battle over the weekend for 500 FedExCup Fall points and the winner's share of the 8 million dollar purse.
stakes: The winner secures a two-year PGA Tour exemption and critical FedExCup Fall positioning for early 2027 Signature Events.
rivalryAngle: Mitchell seeks his second PGA Tour victory while Bridgeman hunts for his breakthrough maiden tour title.
